possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only architecture and merge method, with no training data, evaluation, or safety documentation for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not state what data was used to train or merge the model, so training data provenance and curation are undocumented.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card only says 'text-generation' and gives no intended-use or misuse guidance, leaving downstream risk scope undefined.

specifications.model_size: 15.1 GiB of safetensors weights (16,228,430,992 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was created by merging components using a passthrough merge method with a variation of the Block Expansion method from LLaMA Pro. It has not yet received additional training, so it is expected to perform close to the original model.
